verdict.rationale: The pack documents only retroactive redaction of sensitive data already stored. It also shows before-notify callbacks and SDK-synced discard rules, which ignore or drop whole events. None of this evidences field-level PII scrubbing rules, server-side or in the SDK, that run before payloads persist. Those are adjacent features (post-persistence cleanup and event discarding), not the scrubbing the story asks for.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can scrub PII from error events — server-side scrubbing rules plus SDK-level filtering — before sensitive payloads ever persist
